description: Identify what occupies the nucleophile-facing side (NE2) of the catalytic histidine in CG14717 versus three active family members, and quantify burial of the CG14717 active-site positions
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def af(a):
    j = requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{a}", timeout=60).json()[0]
    return requests.get(j["pdbUrl"], timeout=180).text
def parse(p):
    at={}
    for l in p.splitlines():
        if l.startswith("ATOM"):
            ri=int(l[22:26]); an=l[12:16].strip()
            d=at.setdefault(ri,{"resname":l[17:20].strip(),"plddt":float(l[60:66]),"at":{}})
            d["at"][an]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
    return at

M = {"CG14717 (Q9VGJ4)":parse(af("Q9VGJ4")), "human ABHD11 (Q8NFV4)":parse(af("Q8NFV4")),
     "CG2059 (Q9W3R8)":parse(af("Q9W3R8")), "yeast IMO32 (P53219)":parse(af("P53219"))}

def catalytic_his(st):
    """His whose ND1 accepts an H-bond from an Asp/Glu carboxylate = the catalytic His."""
    best=None
    for ri,r in st.items():
        if r["resname"]!="HIS" or "ND1" not in r["at"]: continue
        for rj,q in st.items():
            if q["resname"] not in ("ASP","GLU"): continue
            for an in ("OD1","OD2","OE1","OE2"):
                if an in q["at"]:
                    d=np.linalg.norm(r["at"]["ND1"]-q["at"][an])
                    if d<3.3 and (best is None or d<best[2]): best=(ri,rj,d,an)
    return best

print("What occupies the nucleophile face (NE2 side) of the catalytic histidine?\n")
rows=[]
for name,st in M.items():
    ch = catalytic_his(st)
    hi, ai, dh, an = ch
    ne2 = st[hi]["at"]["NE2"]
    near=[]
    for ri,r in st.items():
        if ri==hi: continue
        for a2,c in r["at"].items():
            if a2 in ("N","C","O","CA","CB"): continue   # side-chain polar/functional atoms only
            d=np.linalg.norm(c-ne2)
            if d<4.5: near.append((round(float(d),2), f"{r['resname']}{ri} {a2}"))
    near.sort()
    print(f"{name}")
    print(f"   catalytic His{hi}  <-ND1 {dh:.2f} A-  {st[ai]['resname']}{ai} {an}  (acid)")
    print(f"   atoms within 4.5 A of His{hi} NE2: " + (", ".join(f'{n} ({d} A)' for d,n in near[:6]) or "none"))
    rows.append((name, hi, f"{st[ai]['resname']}{ai}", dh, near[0] if near else (np.nan,"none")))
    print()

# ---------------- final figure ----------------
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(13.2, 5.2))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(1, 2, width_ratios=[1.15, 1], wspace=0.3)

ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
labels = [r[0] for r in rows]
d_first = [r[4][0] for r in rows]
names_first = [r[4][1] for r in rows]
cols = ["#c0392b" if "ASP" in n or "GLU" in n else "#2b7a3d" for n in names_first]
y = np.arange(len(rows))
ax.barh(y, d_first, color=cols, edgecolor="k", linewidth=.6)
for i,(d,n) in enumerate(zip(d_first,names_first)):
    ax.text(d+0.06, i, f"{n}  {d} A", va="center", fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(3.5, color="k", ls="--", lw=1)
ax.text(3.55, -0.62, "3.5 A H-bond limit", fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(labels, fontsize=9); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlim(0, 6.2); ax.set_xlabel("distance from catalytic His NE2 (A)")
ax.set_title("L  The closest side-chain partner of the catalytic histidine\n"
             "green = nucleophilic hydroxyl, red = carboxylate", fontsize=10, loc="left")

ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
st = M["CG14717 (Q9VGJ4)"]
allA = np.array([c for r in st.values() for c in r["at"].values()])
vals = []
for ri,r in st.items():
    p = r["at"].get("CB", r["at"].get("CA"))
    if p is None: continue
    vals.append((ri, int((np.linalg.norm(allA-p,axis=1)<10).sum())-len(r["at"])))
v = np.array([x[1] for x in vals])
ax.hist(v, bins=30, color="#bbbbbb", edgecolor="w")
for ri, lab, c in [(53,"Asp53 (oxyanion position)","#c0392b"),
                   (120,"Gly120 (nucleophile position)","#e67e22"),
                   (144,"Asp144 (catalytic acid)","#8e44ad"),
                   (282,"His282 (catalytic His)","#2980b9")]:
    val = dict(vals)[ri]
    ax.axvline(val, color=c, lw=2)
    ax.text(val, ax.get_ylim()[1]*(0.95-0.11*[53,120,144,282].index(ri)), f" {lab}\n {val} ({100*(v<val).mean():.0f}th pct)",
            color=c, fontsize=8, va="top")
ax.set_xlabel("heavy-atom neighbours within 10 A of CB (burial proxy)")
ax.set_ylabel("residues")
ax.set_title("M  All four active-site positions of CG14717 are buried\n"
             "(AlphaFold model, 306 residues)", fontsize=10, loc="left")

fig.suptitle("In CG14717 the catalytic histidine is flanked by two carboxylates instead of an acid and a nucleophile",
             fontsize=12.5, y=1.0)
plt.show()
